description: A React component module defining styled text components (Title, Subtitle, SubtitleLight, Text), a LinkButton, and a Pill component, used for rendering styled UI elements within a preferences or settings context.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled h2 element serving as a title.

methods.name: Subtitle
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled h4 element serving as a subtitle.

methods.name: SubtitleLight
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled h4 element with lighter styling for subtitles.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled paragraph element for displaying text.

methods.name: LinkButton
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled anchor element functioning as a button link with optional click handler.

methods.name: Pill
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled div with color based on ButtonStyle, used as a badge or label.
